rulePubDate:
<js>
var html = String(java.getString('.well@text'));
var resultParts = [];
var time=java.getString('.duration@text');
resultParts.push('🔁' + time);

var data = html.replace(/.*添加时间:([^作者]+)作者.*/, '$1').replace(/\s*/g, '');
if (data && data.trim() !== '' && data !== html) {
resultParts.push('⏰' + data);
}
var author = html.replace(/.*作者:([^热度]+)热度.*/, '$1');
if (author && author.trim() !== '' && author !== html) {
resultParts.push('👤' + author);
}
var hotMatch = html.match(/.*热度:([^收藏]+)收藏.*/);
if (hotMatch && hotMatch[1]) {
var hot = parseInt(hotMatch[1].trim());
if (!isNaN(hot) && hot !== 0) {
resultParts.push('🔥' + hot);
}
}
resultParts.join(' ')
</js>
